description:
Shelf Stocking, Receiving/Storage/Holding Area (RSHA), and Custodial Operations at the Memphis NSA (Naval Support Activity) Commissary.The contractor shall furnish all personnel, supervision, supplies, equipment, tools, materials and other items and services as necessary to perform shelf stocking, RSHA, and custodial services at the Memphis NSA Commissary.Note: This requirement was previously synopsized under Notice ID number HQC00826RE0002 and will now be issued as an RFQ under HQC00826QE0006.

Note: This is a pre-solicitation notice (synopsis) and is not a solicitation. No proposals or quotes are being requested at this time.
